Navin's rules for this task (follow every one):
[G-01] Everything taught comes from the book. Knowledge from outside the book is allowed only to explain the book better; it is marked as outside, standard textbook-level and correct. Never invent facts, numbers, names or quotations.
[G-02] Work like the best teacher of these learners and this exam, not like a summariser. Depth beats brevity: nothing teachable on the page is skipped or compressed away, and every explanation makes a student understand, not just remember. Depth means understanding, not length: lesson narration keeps S2-01's time by cutting repetition and side-tracks, never book content.
[G-03] Before the output, fill 'notes' with brief notes for the reviewer and for Navin: what this unit is about, the key questions a teacher must answer about it, the main decisions you made with a one-line reason each, and anything uncertain. Keep the notes short; they explain the work, they are not the work.
[G-04] Learner-facing language follows the course setting. For the first course (UPSC / State PCS) it is Hinglish: natural Hindi sentence flow, English technical terms, the way Navin teaches.
[G-05] Never drop or compress away what the book teaches to fit a length. If a unit of work is too large, it is split by BIE into smaller units; within a unit, the book's content is complete. Lesson narration has a time target (S2-01), met by cutting repetition and side-tracks, never book content.
[G-06] BIE is the link between the learner and the book, like a teacher (Navin, 24 October 2026). The book is the base; BIE carries its text, easy or hard, into the learner's mind. Never just read the line out: every book line is opened (what its words mean, why it is so, where it is seen, what follows), at the depth of the level profile.
[G-07] Two layers, like a film (Navin, 24 October 2026). The writer layer (understanding, plan, script) decides what is said and how deep, following the level profile and the book's own level. The presentation layer (director, video blocks, render) is the same skilled quality for every learner, from class 6 to postgraduate; only the detail shown follows the level, never the craft.
[S2-01] Plan the chapter's videos from the chapter map: first one short 'pehle yeh jaan lo' video (5-8 minutes) that teaches the chapter's prerequisites, then the topic videos in teaching order. Narration is 6-8 minutes per book page (Navin, 23 October 2026; the 14-page tissue chapter about 85-110 minutes of topic videos, plus the prerequisite video): each topic video gets the share of the pages its items come from, and a very dense page may go up to 25% over when the plan says why. Understanding (Section 1) and the chapter map have no time limit.
[S2-02] Write a spoken teacher script in beats with a natural teacher flow. Stories and analogies only where they genuinely help that topic. Every item the book teaches is taught and every teacher question answered from the book is answered; questions answered from outside the book are used only where they help and the time allows. Cut repetition and side-tracks, never book content.
[S2-03] Prerequisites are only what this chapter directly needs, never a prerequisite of a prerequisite. They are taught, not named, in the chapter's 'pehle yeh jaan lo' video, each with a simple explanation and an example; a topic video may remind of them in at most 2 beats.
[S2-04] Spoken Hinglish the way Navin teaches, in mixed script (Navin, 21 and 23 October 2026): Hindi words in Devanagari, English words, above all the book's technical terms, in Roman exactly as the book spells them, as in 'आज हम tissue के बारे में पढ़ेंगे'; a genuinely difficult Hindi word (formal, literary or technical; not in BIE's everyday word list rulebook/simple_hindi.json) gets its English word in brackets right after it, as in 'सतह (surface)'; the screen and subtitles show the bracket and the voice says 'सतह, यानी surface'. Never a bracket after an everyday word or inside an idiom or a fixed phrase ('आम तौर पर', not 'आम तौर (usually) पर'; 'नहीं के बराबर', not 'नहीं के बराबर (equal to)'). Never an English term in Devanagari or a Hindi word in Roman. Numbers as digits; short spoken sentences addressed to one student; questions to the student and natural pauses; no reading out of lists.
[S2-05] Every beat states which chapter-map items it covers and which teacher questions it answers, and those claims must be true: the beat really explains that item and really answers that question.
[S2-06] Teach every part of a video through the universal frame (what the process is, how it works, when and in what order, under which conditions, in what atmosphere) and through the teaching pattern of its content type, step by step in the pattern's order; every item on the task card is really taught, none only named.
[S2-07] Open every book line in the script, never read it out (Navin, 24 October 2026). A new topic opens with a question about something the learner can see, then the name. After any book line the beat carries at least one of: the term's plain meaning with 'yaani' and an everyday image, a why step from a need, an example or the place. Speak complete sentences, not clipped notes. A classification is taught as a family: the overview tree, then every member in the same slots (layer and shape, why it is named so, its special feature, its function with its cause, where it is found by a zoom from the organ, its consequence), then the members compared and a memory trick. A pattern step may be skipped only with a stated reason; one recap per part and one closing recap.
[S2-08] Apply first, name after (Navin, 27 October 2026): in an economics script a concept's real-world example runs BEFORE the beat that names the term: the example beats carry the example's numbers (₹50 → ₹65, buyers 2 → 12 → 3) and walk the mechanism step by step; then the term ('isliye ise demand-pull inflation kehte hain'), then the book's definition, then one line on where the learner meets it in real life. The example is the one Section 1 chose for the item (its place, actors, goods, numbers), economically correct and at the learner's level. The numbers are said the way a teacher tells what happened ('pehle aapke paas 500 rupaye the, kiraane ke 100 diye, ab 400 bache'), never as a state report (S2-09). The term is not named before the example by any teaching beat of the same concept either (a sister part may not explain 'the UPI route' before the ₹100 kirana payment runs; a hook or a question to the student may ask about it): BIE's code sends such a script back.
[S2-09] Complete teacher sentences (Navin's verdict on Money v1, 29 October 2026: 'teacher ki naration uske sentence aise poore ho ki banawati na lage aur cheejen samjhane ki process us par depend hai to unka complete tarike se istemal hona jaruri hai'): the narration tells what happened in full, natural sentences; a story's numbers are said conversationally ('pehle aapke paas 500 rupaye the, kiraane ke 100 diye, ab 400 bache'), never as a ledger's state report ('cash ₹500 से ₹400 हुआ', 'savings ₹0 से ₹500 हुईं'). BIE's code sends such a beat back.
[S2-10] Outside facts carry their dated source (the Money lesson resume -d, 29 October 2026, v10: operational descriptions of UPI, NEFT, RTGS and IMPS added real Indian banking knowledge beyond the book without a dated source): for a competitive-exam learner (level upsc_pcs), a teaching beat whose basis is outside the book, or mixed and naming an institution or system that none of its book lines names, carries its source with its year in `source` ('RBI, NEFT FAQ, 2023'); a story, example, hook, analogy or question needs none; a beat whose facts the book line says has basis 'book'. BIE's code sends such a beat back; the review page lists the outside beats with their sources.
[W-01] The narration never points at the book: no 'book के अनुसार', 'किताब कहती है', 'book says', 'page पर', 'textbook', 'NCERT' or any wording of that family (the list in this file, 'wording'). BIE's content types (the type of an item decides its required questions and how it is taught, shown, played and drawn):
- process · Process: Something that happens in steps or stages over time: a mechanism, a procedure, a cycle (photosynthesis, cell division, how a bill becomes law). Required questions: how (kaise), when (kab). Other questions: what (kya), where (kahan), why (kyun), consequence (nateeja).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the result first (what it makes). 2) inputs and the place. 3) each step with its cause and its condition. 4) what breaks when a step fails. 5) the whole run once more at speed. 6) recap as a flow.
- structure · Structure: Something made of parts arranged in space, each part with a function (a cell, a leaf, the heart, a machine, the Parliament). Required questions: what (kya), where (kahan). Other questions: how (kaise), why (kyun), which (kaun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the whole in context. 2) zoom into each part in a fixed path (outside to inside). 3) function of each part tied to its shape. 4) how the parts work together. 5) labelled recap.
- classification · Classification: A group divided into kinds by a stated basis (types of tissues, kinds of rocks, kinds of writs). Required questions: which (kaun), difference (tulna). Other questions: what (kya), evidence (saboot), where (kahan).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the overview tree first: the basis of division and every member named. 2) every member in the same slots: layer and shape, why it is named so, its special feature, its function with its cause, where it is found by a zoom from the organ, its consequence. 3) the members compared side by side, the most confused pair named directly. 4) a memory trick for the family.
- comparison · Comparison: Two or more things set side by side on stated criteria (plant and animal cells, Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha). Required questions: compare (tulna), difference (tulna). Other questions: what (kya), why (kyun), evidence (saboot).
  Teaching pattern: 1) what is common. 2) criteria one at a time, both sides together. 3) the reason behind each difference. 4) the most confused pair named directly. 5) difference table as recap.
- timeline · Timeline: Events placed in time: history, the development of an idea, stages of a life (the Revolt of 1857, evolution of cell theory). Required questions: when (kab), why (kyun). Other questions: who (kaun), where (kahan), consequence (nateeja).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the period and its atmosphere. 2) events in order with their causes. 3) the people and their choices. 4) the turning point. 5) what changed after. 6) timeline recap.
- cause_effect · Reasoning (cause and effect): Why something happens: causes, effects, conditions and chains of reasoning (why tissues specialise, why prices rise, why a law was needed). Required questions: why (kyun), how (kaise). Other questions: consequence (nateeja), evidence (saboot), exception (tulna).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the effect students can see. 2) the cause. 3) each link of the chain with its mechanism. 4) the evidence. 5) the exception or limit. 6) the chain as recap.
- facts_numbers · Facts and numbers: Stated facts, quantities, measurements, statistics and formulas (heart rate 72 per minute, 3,000 against 50,000 soldiers at Plassey, F = ma). Required questions: what (kya), evidence (saboot). Other questions: compare (tulna), why (kyun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the fact in one line. 2) the number shown to scale against something familiar. 3) where it comes from (book or outside, dated). 4) what it changes or proves. 5) a formula built term by term when there is one.
- figure · Figure: A diagram, photo, map, graph or table drawing on the page whose content is visual (tissue pages 2, 7 and 8 are figures only). Required questions: what (kya), which (kaun). Other questions: how (kaise), why (kyun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) what the figure is and why it is here. 2) a reading path across it (labels in order). 3) the one thing to remember from it. 4) link back to the text it explains.
- definition · Definition: A term and its meaning as the book states it (tissue, meristem, sovereignty). Required questions: what (kya), evidence (saboot). Other questions: about (kya), why (kyun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) a concrete example first. 2) the book's definition word by word. 3) a non-example that tests the boundary. 4) where the term is used next in the chapter.

The card is BIE's instruction; the source is the material.

- card.coverage.must_cover lists every item this video must teach: each must be in covers_item_ids of a beat that really explains it.

- Terms: fewer technical terms: only the ones the exam asks, each opened with its plain meaning and an everyday image; a term the exam never asks is explained in words, not named.

How real teachers open a book line (teacher example bank 2026-10-29.1; use these ways, in your own words):
- Open with a question on something visible (every new topic and every new family member): Skin aur stomach, kidney ke upar ek outer layer hai ki nahi? Yeh kis se bani hai? — phir naam: epithelial tissue.
- One everyday image per shape or function (every term that names a shape, a layer or a job): Chaadar bichhi ho to bistar bacha rehta hai = protective sheet. Cube wala game, har side barabar = cuboidal. Building ka pillar = columnar. Farsh ki tiles = squamous, isliye tessellated bhi kehte hain.
- The word root where it helps (a term whose parts carry its meaning): Epi yaani upar; epithelium yaani upar ki parat. Slender yaani long aur narrow.
- Why starts from a need (every why step): Pet mein HCl banta hai, isliye andar ek lining chahiye jo khud na jale. Cells bahar ki taraf hain, tootne ka chance zyada, isliye regeneration zyada.
- Contrast with the neighbour (members of one family, and what the exam confuses): Simple epithelium ka kaam protection nahi, woh compound ka hai. Zyada layers = pathogen andar nahi aata.
- Ask and repeat the key word (the one word the learner must keep): Irregular walls. Kaisi? Irregular.
- Exam memory beats by level (after the understanding, by the level profile): Yaad rakhna: brush border PCT mein. Doosre naam: pavement, tessellated. M2B = muscle to bone = tendon, B2B = bone to bone = ligament.
- Link to something already known (a new place or a new structure): Peritoneum, jaise lungs ke aas-paas pleura aur heart ke aas-paas pericardium: wahi kaam, pet ke andar.
- Meaning with two or three real examples (an abstract word in the book): Sensory perception yaani pehchanna: thanda lagna, dard hona, pressure mehsoos karna.
- Open the book's adjective (Navin's example) (a book line names a kind of surface, job or place without saying what it is): Book: 'epithelium absorptive aur secretive surfaces par milta hai'. Video v8: Note पहचानना, उसका promise समझना और MANI
Goal: Learner banknote features के identification, accessibility और security functions समझेगा; ₹1-note exception, language counts, promise clause, bearer status और legal promissory-note distinction अलग करेगा; MANI का काम और उसकी सीमा समझेगा।
Opening hook: Note पर लिखे promise का मतलब क्या हर बार उतना ही सामान मिलना है—और note देख न पाने वाला व्यक्ति उसकी denomination कैसे पहचाने?
Story or analogy: Note का fixed visual reading path होगा: पहचान, accessibility, security और issuer/signatory। फिर promise को face value, purchasing power और gold redemption की अलग comparisons से खोलेंगे। MANI के पहचानने वाले काम को authenticity जाँच मानने की गलती से अलग करेंगे।
Planned minutes: 8
Narration time (S2-01): 7.1-9.5 minutes, about 923-1235 spoken words (BIE counts 130 words a minute)
Prerequisites already taught in the prerequisite video (remind of one in at most 2 beats): Purchases, prices, debts and payments due later; Bank balances, deposits, loans and interest; Denominations, monetary arithmetic, percentages and minimum–maximum limits; Purchasing power, inflation, scarcity and liquidity; Central bank, commercial bank, government treasury and bank-to-bank settlement; Foreign currencies, exchange rates, reserves and demand–supply changes; Chronological reading: BCE/CE, centuries, dynasties and law versus implementation dates; Digital instructions, identity authentication, ledgers and payment interfaces
Open every book line (S2-07): a question about something the learner can see, then the name; every term opened: its plain meaning with 'yaani' and one everyday image (the word root where it helps); the why, starting from a need or a problem, one link at a time; an example or the place, by a zoom from the organ or the thing the learner knows; the consequence: what follows, and the link to the previous or the next idea; the contrast: what it is not, and what the exam confuses it with; the memory beat by level: the exam's 'yaad rakhna', the other names, the trick.

p009-i10 | 9 | list_point | structure | Accessibility Features: Designed for visually impaired users. Raised printing, Identification marks, Larger numerals, Distinct note sizes.
  p009-i10#q1 | what | Which accessibility features are listed? → Raised printing and identification marks provide recognition cues, while larger numerals and distinct note sizes are additional listed aids for visually impaired users. | book
  p009-i10#q2 | where | Where do these aids occur? → They are features of the Indian notes discussed in this section. | book
  p009-i10#q3 | how | How do these features address different degrees of visual impairment? → Raised print and marks can supply tactile cues; larger numerals can help people with residual vision, and size differences provide another way to distinguish notes. | outside
  term | Accessibility Features | yaani ऐसी बनावट जिससे कम दिखने पर भी नोट पहचानना आसान हो | image: आँख बंद करके उभरा हुआ निशान महसूस करना
  why | A user must identify a note even when small printed details are difficult to see. [standard] → Touch, numeral size and note size offer additional recognition cues. [standard]
  example or place | Raised printing and numerals on a currency note.
  consequence | Supports more independent use of cash.
  visual | Feel a raised mark and enlarge the numeral.
  level extra | Accessibility and security may overlap: intaglio printing serves both discussions on this page.
p009-i11 | 9 | list_point | facts_numbers | ₹1 Note: Issued by the Govt of India. Contains the signature of Finance Secretary of India. RBI manages the circulation of this note.
  p009-i11#q1 | what | What three institutional roles must be distinguished for the ₹1 note? → Government of India issues it, the Finance Secretary of India signs it, and RBI manages its circulation. | book
  p009-i11#q2 | evidence | Does RBI's circulation role make RBI the issuer in this entry? → No. The page expressly assigns issue to the Government of India and circulation management to RBI. | book
  p009-i11#q3 | why | Why is separating these roles important? → Issuing a currency instrument, signing it and distributing it are different responsibilities; an institution involved in circulation need not be its issuer. | outside
  term | circulation | yaani पैसे का लोगों और बैंकों के बीच चलन में रहना | image: नोट बैंक से दुकान और दुकान से ग्राहक तक जाता है
  why | A note needs both an issuing authority and arrangements to move through the economy. [standard] → The page assigns these roles separately for the ₹1 note. [book]
  example or place | The ₹1 note.
  consequence | Prevents the incorrect inference that circulation management equals issue.
  visual | Split issuer, signatory and circulation into three boxes.
  level extra | Remember: Government—issue; Finance Secretary—signature; RBI—circulation.
p009-i12 | 9 | list_point | facts_numbers | https://paisaboltahai.rbi.org.in/: You can access the features of our notes from this website of RBI.
  p009-i12#q1 | what | What resource does the book provide? → It directs readers to RBI's Paisa Bolta Hai website to access information on note features. | book
  p009-i12#q2 | evidence | Why is this link relevant rather than publisher boilerplate? → The book explicitly identifies it as an RBI resource for the note features being taught. | book
  p009-i12#q3 | how | How should learners use denomination-specific reference material? → They can compare the features of a particular note rather than assuming one generic feature list applies identically to every note. | outside
  why | Specific notes can require specific checks, so a reference resource is useful. [standard] → The page supplies RBI's website for note features. [book]
  example or place | https://paisaboltahai.rbi.org.in/
  consequence | Supports checking details by note rather than overgeneralising.
  visual | Point to the printed RBI link.
  level extra | The website was not accessed for this reading.
p009-i13 | 9 | list_point | facts_numbers | Languages: 15 languages appear in the language panel on the reverse. Along with Hindi (front) and English (front), the note represents 17 languages in total.
  p009-i13#q1 | what | How many languages are in the panel and how many in total? → The reverse language panel contains 15; adding Hindi and English on the front gives 17 represented languages. | book
  p009-i13#q2 | evidence | What explains the difference between the two counts? → The page locates the group of 15 in the reverse panel and separately identifies Hindi and English on the front. | book
  p009-i13#q3 | how | How should a candidate handle a statement saying 'the language panel contains 17 languages'? → It confuses the total for the note with the panel count: the book gives 15 for that panel, not 17. | book
  term | language panel | yaani नोट का वह हिस्सा जहाँ कई भाषाओं में रकम लिखी होती है | image: एक ही कीमत को कई भाषाओं में लिखी हुई सूची
  why | Readers need to distinguish a specific panel from the whole note. [standard] → The page's total adds front-side Hindi and English to the 15-language reverse panel. [book]
  example or place | Front and reverse of the note.
  consequence | Avoids the common 15-versus-17 count trap.
  visual | Flip the note and count 15 + 2.
  level extra | The page does not list the 15 languages individually.
p009-i15 | 9 | list_point | structure | Watermark of Mahatma Gandhi.
  p009-i15#q1 | what | What watermark is identified? → The listed watermark depicts Mahatma Gandhi and is one of the note's security features. | book
  p009-i15#q2 | where | Where is a watermark formed? → It is a feature within the paper, rather than simply an ordinary surface-printed portrait. | outside
  p009-i15#q3 | how | How can a learner distinguish it from an ordinary printed image? → Holding the note against light reveals tonal variation in the paper that forms the watermark image. | outside
  term | Watermark | yaani कागज़ में बना हल्का चित्र जो रोशनी में साफ दिखता है | image: कागज़ को खिड़की की रोशनी के सामने उठाना
  why | A surface picture can be copied more easily than a feature formed within paper. [standard] → A watermark supplies an additional authenticity cue. [standard]
  example or place | Mahatma Gandhi watermark in note paper.
  consequence | Provides a look-against-light check.
  visual | Lift the note toward light.
  level extra | A watermark is not the same feature as the see-through register.
p009-i16 | 9 | list_point | structure | Security Thread with "भारत", "RBI", and denomination.
  p009-i16#q1 | what | What identifying information does the listed thread carry? → The page names भारत, RBI and the denomination as thread inscriptions. | book
  p009-i16#q2 | where | Where is a security thread situated? → It is incorporated into the note paper; depending on note design, portions may be visible at the surface. | outside
  p009-i16#q3 | why | Why inspect a thread instead of accepting a drawn line as equivalent? → A genuine thread is a constructed security component with identifying detail, not merely a dark stripe printed on paper. | outside
  term | Security Thread | yaani नोट के कागज़ में डाली गई पहचान वाली पतली पट्टी | image: कपड़े में बुनी हुई पट्टी, सिर्फ ऊपर खींची लकीर नहीं
  why | A line on a copy is not enough to establish authenticity. [standard] → A thread and its inscriptions add details that can be checked. [standard]
  example or place | Thread within a banknote.
  consequence | Adds a check separate from the watermark.
  visual | Magnify the thread inscriptions.
  level extra | Denomination means the stated monetary value, such as ₹100.
p009-i17 | 9 | list_point | structure | Latent Image visible when tilted.
  p009-i17#q1 | what | What is the listed latent-image feature? → It is an image whose visibility is revealed by tilting the note, rather than relying on a straight-on view. | book
  p009-i17#q2 | where | Where does the viewing change occur? → The observer changes the angle between the note surface and the line of sight. | outside
  p009-i17#q3 | how | How does this differ from a fixed photocopied image? → A static copy may reproduce a visible pattern, but not necessarily the angle-dependent appearance that the feature is intended to provide. | outside
  term | Latent Image | yaani ऐसा छिपा चित्र जो खास कोण से देखने पर उभरता है | image: कार्ड को तिरछा करते ही छिपा पैटर्न दिखना
  why | A flat image alone offers limited authentication. [standard] → Changing viewing angle supplies a different check. [standard]
  example or place | The note's angle-dependent image.
  consequence | Encourages a tilt check rather than only a glance.
  visual | Tilt and reveal.
  level extra | The page does not specify the feature's exact position or angle.
p009-i18 | 9 | list_point | structure | See-through Register that forms the denomination when viewed against light.
  p009-i18#q1 | what | What does the see-through register show? → It forms the denomination when the note is viewed against light. | book
  p009-i18#q2 | where | Where are the contributing portions located? → Complementary portions are printed on opposite faces so their alignment can be checked through the paper. | outside
  p009-i18#q3 | how | How does holding the note to light test this feature? → Transmitted light lets the viewer see the front and back portions together; correct alignment produces the complete numeral. | outside
  term | See-through Register | yaani आगे-पीछे के अधूरे निशान जो रोशनी में मिलकर पूरी रकम दिखाते हैं | image: दो अधूरे चित्र सही जगह मिलने पर पूरा चित्र बनना
  why | A copy must reproduce not just shapes but their two-sided alignment. [standard] → Viewing through the note tests whether the portions form the denomination. [book]
  example or place | Aligned denomination portions on the note's two faces.
  consequence | Adds a registration check distinct from a watermark.
  visual | Align the two halves through light.
  level extra | Register here refers to accurate alignment, not a written record book.
p009-i19 | 9 | list_point | structure | Micro-lettering reading "RBI" and the denomination.
  p009-i19#q1 | what | What is written in the listed micro-lettering? → The very small lettering reads RBI and the denomination. | book
  p009-i19#q2 | where | Where should the learner look for this feature? → In the note's fine printed details rather than expecting ordinary headline-sized letters; this page does not give an exact location. | outside
  p009-i19#q3 | why | Why can tiny lettering be useful? → Fine, sharp text is harder to reproduce clearly with a crude copy; magnification can help distinguish lettering from blurred marks. | outside
  term | Micro-lettering | yaani बहुत छोटे आकार में छपे अक्षर या अंक | image: लेंस से देखने पर छोटी लकीर में अक्षर दिखना

  example or place | Tiny RBI and denomination printing.
  consequence | Adds a magnified-detail check.
  visual | Zoom into the tiny letters.
  level extra | Do not confuse micro-lettering with large accessibility numerals.
p009-i20 | 9 | list_point | structure | Optically Variable Ink on higher denominations.
  p009-i20#q1 | what | What special ink is named? → The page lists Optically Variable Ink among major security features. | book
  p009-i20#q2 | where | Where does the page say it is used? → It associates this ink with higher denominations, without specifying individual values. | book
  p009-i20#q3 | how | How does optically variable ink help checking? → Its apparent colour changes with viewing angle, providing an effect that an ordinary static colour print does not reproduce in the same way. | outside
  term | Optically Variable Ink | yaani ऐसी स्याही जिसका रंग देखने का कोण बदलने पर बदला हुआ दिखे | image: चमकीली चीज़ को घुमाने पर रंग बदलता दिखना

beats.say: ₹100 का promise क्या हमेशा उतना सामान दिलाता है? Note दिखे नहीं, तो उसकी value कैसे पहचानोगे?
beats.on_screen: ₹100 note, basket and phone.

beats.say: छोटे अंक न दिखें तो? Accessibility Features यानी पहचान आसान बनाने वाली बनावट: raised printing और identification marks छूकर पहचानो; larger numerals और distinct note sizes भी मदद करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Whole note: tactile marks, larger numerals, different sizes.

beats.say: रोशनी में कौन दिखता है? Watermark में Mahatma Gandhi कागज़ के भीतर दिखते हैं, ऊपर छपा portrait नहीं। Security Thread कागज़ में डाली पतली strip है; उसके भारत, RBI और denomination देखो, सिर्फ dark line नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Against light: reveal paper watermark; zoom into incorporated thread and inscriptions. Do not invent exact positions.

beats.say: Tilt पर चित्र उभरे? Latent Image देखने का angle बदलकर जाँचते हैं। See-through Register में आगे-पीछे के अधूरे निशान रोशनी में पूरी denomination बनाते हैं; यहाँ दोनों faces का alignment जाँचते हो, भीतर बना portrait नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Tilt to reveal latent image; then transmitted light aligns opposite-face portions. Contrast with watermark.

beats.say: Lens में छोटी line अक्षर बन जाए तो? Micro-lettering यानी बहुत छोटे अक्षरों में RBI और denomination; crude copy में ये धुँधले मिल सकते हैं। Higher denominations की Optically Variable Ink यानी tilt पर रंग बदलने वाली ink, जैसे चमकीला card घुमाओ; छिपा चित्र उभरना अलग check है।
beats.on_screen: Magnify fine printing: a tiny line resolves into RBI and denomination. Tilt ink to show colour change; contrast with latent-image appearance. Do not assert exact positions.

beats.say: उँगली से उभार मिले? Intaglio Printing में छपे हिस्से raised होते हैं, पूरा कागज़ नहीं। Number Panels में छोटे से बड़े होते digits trace करो; यह printing-pattern check है, रकम बढ़ना नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Feel selected raised printed areas; trace increasing physical digit size in number panel, separate from language panel.

beats.say: भीतर की बनावट और बारीक छपाई अलग checks देते हैं; Intaglio touch-based पहचान भी देता है।
beats.on_screen: Connect paper construction, fine printing and raised detail to their checking functions.

beats.say: Checks साथ लगाओ; features denomination और design के साथ बदल सकते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Combine inspection actions; consult denomination-specific design.

beats.say: रास्ता याद रखो: light, tilt, magnify और touch।
beats.on_screen: Labelled recap of all eight security features and accessibility aids along the inspection path.

beats.say: ₹1 note कौन issue करता है? Government of India; signature Finance Secretary का है और circulation RBI संभालता है, यानी लोगों-बैंकों के बीच चलना।
beats.on_screen: ₹1: Government issues; Finance Secretary signs; RBI manages circulation.

beats.say: पीछे language panel में क्या दिखता है? यानी एक ही रकम 15 languages में लिखी है। Note के features मिलाने के लिए RBI की पैसा बोलता है website देख सकते हो।
beats.on_screen: Reverse language panel: highlight the same monetary amount expressed in 15 languages. Official RBI feature reference: https://paisaboltahai.rbi.org.in/

beats.say: सामने Hindi और English जोड़ो तो total 17 हैं; जैसे कमरे और पूरे घर की गिनती अलग होती है।
beats.on_screen: Reverse 15 + front 2 = total 17.

beats.say: RBI reference से denomination-specific features मिलाओ। ₹1 का circulation RBI संभालता है; इससे वह issuer नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: Official feature reference; circulation ≠ issue.

beats.say: Statement trap पकड़ो: panel में 17 गलत है; circulation संभालना और issuer होना अलग काम हैं।
beats.on_screen: Panel 17: false. RBI issuer of ₹1: false.

beats.say: 15 plus 2; तीन institutional roles; features के लिए RBI reference याद रखो।
beats.on_screen: 15 + 2 = 17; issuer/signatory/circulation; official feature reference.

beats.say: किराना bill ₹100 हो, genuine ₹100 note दो तो? दुकानदार लेता है; bill ₹100 से ₹0 हुआ, कागज़ नहीं, ₹100 की रकम काम आई।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical grocery bill ₹100 → ₹0.

beats.say: Tea seller को ₹20 मिले, फिर वही note milk seller को दे? दोनों की इस note में holding बारी-बारी ₹0 से ₹20 हुई; नाम नहीं बदलना पड़ा।
beats.on_screen: Lawful transfer: customer → tea seller → milk seller.

beats.say: Wallet का ₹100 interest कमाएगा? नहीं। Groceries लेने पर ग्राहक की holding ₹100 से ₹0, shopkeeper की ₹0 से ₹100 हुई; holder बदला।
beats.on_screen: No interest from holding; unnamed ₹100 transferred.

beats.say: ₹500 debt के लिए खरीदार unconditional written commitment देता है। बाद में currency से चुकाए तो debt ₹500 से ₹0 हुआ; commitment और currency अलग हैं।
beats.on_screen: Illustrative written repayment commitment; later currency payment.

beats.say: लिखी amount face value है; Promise Clause उस face value की RBI guarantee बताता है। Bearer वह है जिसके पास note है, किसी तय व्यक्ति का नाम जरूरी नहीं; इसीलिए मिला हुआ cash अगले payment में चलता है।
beats.on_screen: Face value: stated amount. Bearer: present holder.

beats.say: इसीलिए zero interest, anonymous bearer bond कहते हैं: interest नहीं, holder का नाम नहीं, इस्तेमाल bearer करता है; promise nominal amount का है।
beats.on_screen: Zero interest / unnamed holder / bearer use.

beats.say: Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 के Section 4 extract में promissory note written instrument है, जिसमें unconditional undertaking यानी बिना शर्त वादा हो; ‘not being a bank-note or a currency-note’ इन्हें बाहर रखता है।
beats.on_screen: Section 4 extract: written instrument; unconditional undertaking; explicit exclusions.

beats.say: ‘फसल अच्छी हुई तो दूँगा’ unconditional नहीं है। Bearer bond यहाँ shorthand है, ordinary investment bond नहीं; anonymous से हर transaction untraceable नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: Conditional non-example; shorthand is not full legal classification.

beats.say: Face value, bearer और legal category अलग रखो; यह पूरी statutory definition नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Monetary meanings versus statutory classification; quotation is an extract.

beats.say: Note देकर silver मिले तो? मान लो ₹100 पर 10 grams silver मिले; यह historical rate नहीं। Note लौटाने पर holder के notes ₹100 से ₹0, silver 0 से 10 grams हुए।
beats.on_screen: Explicitly hypothetical parity, not colonial historical terms: surrender ₹100 note; holder notes ₹100 → ₹0; silver 0 → 10 g.

beats.say: Authority का silver reserve 100 से 90 grams हुआ; लौटाया note cancel हुआ तो note liability ₹100 घटी। यह metal conversion है; colonial era का promise gold या silver bars अथवा coins में था। Full bodied coin में metal की कीमत बताई कीमत के करीब थी।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical authority reserve 100 → 90 g; cancel returned note; outstanding note liability decreases ₹100. Then label historical metal conversion; full-bodied coin.

beats.say: Metal quantity तय नियम से मिलती थी, कागज़ के वजन से नहीं; modern note ऐसा redemption नहीं देता।
beats.on_screen: Historical terms varied by system and period; modern note has no specified metal redemption.

beats.say: पुराना run था: note लौटाओ, metal लो, note cancel हो।
beats.on_screen: Historical convertible arrangement: surrender → metal transfer → cancellation; hypothetical numbers remain labelled.

beats.say: पुराने Dollar और Pound में क्या साझा था? Bretton Woods का Dollar और British Rule का Pound Sterling metal से जुड़े थे; यानी कागज़ के पीछे metal लेने का रास्ता था।
beats.on_screen: Shared historical metal link; actual redemption terms differed across systems.

beats.say: मान लो चावल ₹20 से ₹25 per kilogram हुए। ₹100 से 5 की जगह 4 kilograms मिलेंगे; पुराने 5 लेने को ₹125 चाहिए। क्या note बदला?
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical rice example: ₹20 → ₹25/kg; 5 → 4 kg; 20% less rice.

beats.say: नहीं; face value वही, purchasing power कम है: note inflation adjusted नहीं। Metal redemption अलग अधिकार है; modern note gold या silver weight से linked नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Separate criteria: purchasing power and metal redemption.

beats.say: Currency पर promise है, तो legal promissory note है? नहीं; Section 4 का express exclusion मिलता-जुलता wording होने पर भी category अलग करता है।
beats.on_screen: Promise clause present; legal promissory-note category excluded.

beats.say: Prices बढ़ें तो cash अपने आप नहीं बढ़ता; एक good का example broader inflation नहीं। Bretton Woods redemption foreign official holders का था, हर retail bearer का नहीं।
beats.on_screen: No automatic cash adjustment; historical official-holder limitation.

beats.say: Promise Clause यानी लिखी रकम का वादा; legal promissory note अलग category है, जैसे लिखा वादा देखकर हर कागज़ currency नहीं बन जाता।
beats.on_screen: Printed promise versus statutory category: similar wording does not override Section 4's explicit exclusion.

beats.say: चार tests अलग हैं: face value, purchasing power, metal redemption और legal category।
beats.on_screen: Four-row comparison table.

beats.say: ₹100 specimen में ऊपर-नीचे क्या है? दोनों languages का promise ऊपर है और Governor का signature नीचे; अब इन्हें पहचानो।
beats.on_screen: Enlarged described ₹100 promise/signature crop.

beats.say: बाएँ Hindi, दाएँ English में वही ₹100 हैं, ₹200 नहीं। ‘I PROMISE TO PAY’ रकम देने का वादा है; ‘THE BEARER’ यानी note रखने वाले से यह वादा है।
beats.on_screen: Show complete supplied bilingual promise; connect both amounts to one ₹100 note and bearer to its holder.

beats.say: नीचे Raghuram G. Rajan का नाम, signature और Governor title दिखते हैं। यह specimen का signatory है, current-office दावा नहीं; ₹1 पर Finance Secretary sign करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Show supplied रघुराम जी. राजन, handwritten signature, गवर्नर and GOVERNOR labels; specimen only.

beats.say: Amount, bearer और इस instrument का signatory पहचानो।
beats.on_screen: Highlight amount → bearer → specimen signatory.

beats.say: यहीं face value और bearer दिखते हैं; signature legal category नहीं तय करता।
beats.on_screen: Link specimen to monetary definitions, not statutory classification.

beats.say: दुकान पर note पढ़ न सको तो? दूसरों से पूछे बिना value पहचानना accessibility की जरूरत है।
beats.on_screen: Visually impaired user choosing a note at a shop.

beats.say: RBI ने 1 January 2020 को free MANI—Mobile Aided Note Identifier—launch किया; यानी phone से note पहचानने की मदद।
beats.on_screen: 1 January 2020; RBI; free MANI.

beats.say: अब denomination पहचानने के लिए दूसरे से पूछने का एक alternative मिला।
beats.on_screen: Independent identification becomes available through the app.

beats.say: याद रखो: RBI, 1 January 2020, independent पहचान।
beats.on_screen: Launch timeline and accessibility purpose.

beats.say: हाथ में ₹100 है या ₹500? Denomination यानी note की value पहचानना MANI का उद्देश्य है, ताकि visually impaired व्यक्ति खुद पहचान सके।
beats.on_screen: ₹100 versus ₹500: identify value category.

beats.say: Data बंद हो तो? MANI Android और iOS पर installation के बाद offline, यानी बिना internet चलता है; Hindi-English समेत 15 languages हैं।
beats.on_screen: Both platforms; 15 languages; offline AFTER installation.

beats.say: App की 15 languages को note के 15 plus 2 से मत मिलाना; platform और language choices access बढ़ाते हैं।
beats.on_screen: App language count versus banknote language count.

beats.say: Graphic में audio और vibration बिना देखे पहचान के रास्ते हैं; offline icon installation के बाद का काम बताता है।
beats.on_screen: Speaker and vibration icons demonstrate independent access; offline icon corroborates operation after installation.

beats.say: दो platforms, 15 languages, installed app offline; पहचान authenticity test नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Access capabilities; denomination recognition ≠ authentication.

beats.say: Phone जवाब कैसे देता है? Note की image लेकर रकम sound या vibration से पहुँचाता है।
beats.on_screen: Introduce graphic reading path: camera input → audio → vibration → offline icon.

beats.say: Front या back, कोई side scan करो; camera image input देता है। Audio output denomination सुनाता है, इसलिए screen पढ़ना जरूरी नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Either note face → camera → audible denomination.

beats.say: सुन भी न सकें तो? Vision-hearing impairment में vibration हाथ से महसूस होती है। Network icon installed app का offline use बताता है, offline download नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Vibration felt in hand; offline AFTER installation.

beats.say: Input image है; result सुनकर या छूकर मिलता है।
beats.on_screen: Visual input and alternative sensory outputs.

beats.say: Scan करो, सुनो या vibration पाओ; installation के बाद data जरूरी नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Complete labelled MANI graphic linked to independent denomination identification.

beats.say: पहचान, face-value promise और legal category अलग हैं; MANI रकम पहचानने में मदद करता है, authenticity नहीं बताता।
beats.on_screen: Final synthesis: note checks / monetary promise / legal exclusion / accessible denomination identification.

beats.say: ₹100 का promise क्या हमेशा उतना सामान दिलाता है? Note दिखे नहीं, तो उसकी value कैसे पहचानोगे?
beats.on_screen: ₹100 note, basket and phone.

beats.say: छोटे अंक न दिखें तो? Accessibility Features यानी पहचान आसान बनाने वाली बनावट: raised printing और identification marks छूकर पहचानो; larger numerals और distinct note sizes भी मदद करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Whole note: tactile marks, larger numerals, different sizes.

beats.say: रोशनी में कौन दिखता है? Watermark में Mahatma Gandhi कागज़ के भीतर दिखते हैं, ऊपर छपा portrait नहीं। Security Thread कागज़ में डाली पतली strip है; उसके भारत, RBI और denomination देखो, सिर्फ dark line नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Against light: reveal paper watermark; zoom into incorporated thread and inscriptions. Do not invent exact positions.

beats.say: Tilt पर चित्र उभरे? Latent Image देखने का angle बदलकर जाँचते हैं। See-through Register में आगे-पीछे के अधूरे निशान रोशनी में पूरी denomination बनाते हैं; यहाँ दोनों faces का alignment जाँचते हो, भीतर बना portrait नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Tilt to reveal latent image; then transmitted light aligns opposite-face portions. Contrast with watermark.

beats.say: Lens में छोटी line अक्षर बन जाए तो? Micro-lettering यानी बहुत छोटे अक्षरों में RBI और denomination; crude copy में ये धुँधले मिल सकते हैं। Higher denominations की Optically Variable Ink यानी tilt पर रंग बदलने वाली ink, जैसे चमकीला card घुमाओ; छिपा चित्र उभरना अलग check है।
beats.on_screen: Magnify fine printing: a tiny line resolves into RBI and denomination. Tilt ink to show colour change; contrast with latent-image appearance. Do not assert exact positions.

beats.say: उँगली से उभार मिले? Intaglio Printing में छपे हिस्से raised होते हैं, पूरा कागज़ नहीं। Number Panels में छोटे से बड़े होते digits trace करो; यह printing-pattern check है, रकम बढ़ना नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Feel selected raised printed areas; trace increasing physical digit size in number panel, separate from language panel.

beats.say: भीतर की बनावट और बारीक छपाई अलग checks देते हैं; Intaglio touch-based पहचान भी देता है।
beats.on_screen: Connect paper construction, fine printing and raised detail to their checking functions.

beats.say: Checks साथ लगाओ; features denomination और design के साथ बदल सकते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Combine inspection actions; consult denomination-specific design.

beats.say: रास्ता याद रखो: light, tilt, magnify और touch।
beats.on_screen: Labelled recap of all eight security features and accessibility aids along the inspection path.

beats.say: ₹1 note कौन issue करता है? Government of India; signature Finance Secretary का है और circulation RBI संभालता है, यानी लोगों-बैंकों के बीच चलना।
beats.on_screen: ₹1: Government issues; Finance Secretary signs; RBI manages circulation.

beats.say: पीछे language panel में क्या दिखता है? यानी एक ही रकम 15 languages में लिखी है। Note के features मिलाने के लिए RBI की पैसा बोलता है website देख सकते हो।
beats.on_screen: Reverse language panel: highlight the same monetary amount expressed in 15 languages. Official RBI feature reference: https://paisaboltahai.rbi.org.in/

beats.say: सामने Hindi और English जोड़ो तो total 17 हैं; जैसे कमरे और पूरे घर की गिनती अलग होती है।
beats.on_screen: Reverse 15 + front 2 = total 17.

beats.say: RBI reference से denomination-specific features मिलाओ। ₹1 का circulation RBI संभालता है; इससे वह issuer नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: Official feature reference; circulation ≠ issue.

beats.say: Statement trap पकड़ो: panel में 17 गलत है; circulation संभालना और issuer होना अलग काम हैं।
beats.on_screen: Panel 17: false. RBI issuer of ₹1: false.

beats.say: 15 plus 2; तीन institutional roles; features के लिए RBI reference याद रखो।
beats.on_screen: 15 + 2 = 17; issuer/signatory/circulation; official feature reference.

beats.say: किराना bill ₹100 है; genuine ₹100 note दो तो? दुकानदार ने लिया, अब ₹0 बाकी हैं; payment में कागज़ नहीं, उस पर लिखे ₹100 काम आए।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical grocery bill ₹100 → ₹0.

beats.say: Customer ने tea seller को ₹20 का note दिया; उसने वही milk seller को दिया। पहले दोनों के पास इस note के ₹0 थे; अब बारी-बारी ₹20 मिले, बिना नाम बदले।
beats.on_screen: Lawful transfer: customer → tea seller → milk seller.

beats.say: Wallet का ₹100 interest कमाएगा? नहीं। ग्राहक ने groceries के लिए वह note दिया; उसके पास ₹0 बचे। Shopkeeper के पास पहले इस note के ₹0 थे, अब ₹100 मिले।
beats.on_screen: No interest from holding; unnamed ₹100 transferred.

beats.say: खरीदार ₹500 debt चुकाने का unconditional written commitment देता है। बाद में उसने currency में ₹500 चुका दिए; अब ₹0 बाकी हैं। Written commitment और payment की currency अलग हैं।
beats.on_screen: Illustrative written repayment commitment; later currency payment.

beats.say: लिखी amount face value है; Promise Clause उस face value की RBI guarantee बताता है। Bearer वह है जिसके पास note है, किसी तय व्यक्ति का नाम जरूरी नहीं; इसीलिए मिला हुआ cash अगले payment में चलता है।
beats.on_screen: Face value: stated amount. Bearer: present holder.

beats.say: इसीलिए zero interest, anonymous bearer bond कहते हैं: interest नहीं, holder का नाम नहीं, इस्तेमाल bearer करता है; promise nominal amount का है।
beats.on_screen: Zero interest / unnamed holder / bearer use.

beats.say: Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 के Section 4 extract में promissory note written instrument है, जिसमें unconditional undertaking यानी बिना शर्त वादा हो; ‘not being a bank-note or a currency-note’ इन्हें बाहर रखता है।
beats.on_screen: Section 4 extract: written instrument; unconditional undertaking; explicit exclusions.

beats.say: ‘फसल अच्छी हुई तो दूँगा’ unconditional नहीं है। Bearer bond यहाँ shorthand है, ordinary investment bond नहीं; anonymous से हर transaction untraceable नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: Conditional non-example; shorthand is not full legal classification.

beats.say: Face value, bearer और legal category अलग रखो; यह पूरी statutory definition नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Monetary meanings versus statutory classification; quotation is an extract.

beats.say: Note देकर silver मिले तो? मान लो ₹100 पर 10 grams silver मिले; यह historical rate नहीं। Note लौटाने पर holder के notes ₹100 से ₹0, silver 0 से 10 grams हुए।
beats.on_screen: Explicitly hypothetical parity, not colonial historical terms: surrender ₹100 note; holder notes ₹100 → ₹0; silver 0 → 10 g.

beats.say: Authority का silver reserve 100 से 90 grams हुआ; लौटाया note cancel हुआ तो note liability ₹100 घटी। यह metal conversion है; colonial era का promise gold या silver bars अथवा coins में था। Full bodied coin में metal की कीमत बताई कीमत के करीब थी।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical authority reserve 100 → 90 g; cancel returned note; outstanding note liability decreases ₹100. Then label historical metal conversion; full-bodied coin.

beats.say: Metal quantity तय नियम से मिलती थी, कागज़ के वजन से नहीं; modern note ऐसा redemption नहीं देता।
beats.on_screen: Historical terms varied by system and period; modern note has no specified metal redemption.

beats.say: पुराना run था: note लौटाओ, metal लो, note cancel हो।
beats.on_screen: Historical convertible arrangement: surrender → metal transfer → cancellation; hypothetical numbers remain labelled.

beats.say: पुराने Dollar और Pound में क्या साझा था? Bretton Woods का Dollar और British Rule का Pound Sterling metal से जुड़े थे; यानी कागज़ के पीछे metal लेने का रास्ता था।
beats.on_screen: Shared historical metal link; actual redemption terms differed across systems.

beats.say: मान लो चावल ₹20 से ₹25 per kilogram हुए। ₹100 से 5 की जगह 4 kilograms मिलेंगे; पुराने 5 लेने को ₹125 चाहिए। क्या note बदला?
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical rice example: ₹20 → ₹25/kg; 5 → 4 kg; 20% less rice.

beats.say: नहीं; face value वही, purchasing power कम है: note inflation adjusted नहीं। Metal redemption अलग अधिकार है; modern note gold या silver weight से linked नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Separate criteria: purchasing power and metal redemption.

beats.say: Currency पर promise है, तो legal promissory note है? नहीं; Section 4 का express exclusion मिलता-जुलता wording होने पर भी category अलग करता है।
beats.on_screen: Promise clause present; legal promissory-note category excluded.

beats.say: Prices बढ़ें तो cash अपने आप नहीं बढ़ता; एक good का example broader inflation नहीं। Bretton Woods redemption foreign official holders का था, हर retail bearer का नहीं।
beats.on_screen: No automatic cash adjustment; historical official-holder limitation.

beats.say: Promise Clause यानी लिखी रकम का वादा; legal promissory note अलग category है, जैसे लिखा वादा देखकर हर कागज़ currency नहीं बन जाता।
beats.on_screen: Printed promise versus statutory category: similar wording does not override Section 4's explicit exclusion.

beats.say: चार tests अलग हैं: face value, purchasing power, metal redemption और legal category।
beats.on_screen: Four-row comparison table.

beats.say: ₹100 specimen में ऊपर-नीचे क्या है? दोनों languages का promise ऊपर है और Governor का signature नीचे; अब इन्हें पहचानो।
beats.on_screen: Enlarged described ₹100 promise/signature crop.

beats.say: बाएँ Hindi, दाएँ English में वही ₹100 हैं, ₹200 नहीं। ‘I PROMISE TO PAY’ रकम देने का वादा है; ‘THE BEARER’ यानी note रखने वाले से यह वादा है।
beats.on_screen: Show complete supplied bilingual promise; connect both amounts to one ₹100 note and bearer to its holder.

beats.say: नीचे Raghuram G. Rajan का नाम, signature और Governor title दिखते हैं। यह specimen का signatory है, current-office दावा नहीं; ₹1 पर Finance Secretary sign करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Show supplied रघुराम जी. राजन, handwritten signature, गवर्नर and GOVERNOR labels; specimen only.

beats.say: Amount, bearer और इस instrument का signatory पहचानो।
beats.on_screen: Highlight amount → bearer → specimen signatory.

beats.say: यहीं face value और bearer दिखते हैं; signature legal category नहीं तय करता।
beats.on_screen: Link specimen to monetary definitions, not statutory classification.

beats.say: दुकान पर note पढ़ न सको तो? दूसरों से पूछे बिना value पहचानना accessibility की जरूरत है।
beats.on_screen: Visually impaired user choosing a note at a shop.

beats.say: RBI ने 1 January 2020 को free MANI—Mobile Aided Note Identifier—launch किया; यानी phone से note पहचानने की मदद।
beats.on_screen: 1 January 2020; RBI; free MANI.

beats.say: अब denomination पहचानने के लिए दूसरे से पूछने का एक alternative मिला।
beats.on_screen: Independent identification becomes available through the app.

beats.say: याद रखो: RBI, 1 January 2020, independent पहचान।
beats.on_screen: Launch timeline and accessibility purpose.

beats.say: हाथ में ₹100 है या ₹500? Denomination यानी note की value पहचानना MANI का उद्देश्य है, ताकि visually impaired व्यक्ति खुद पहचान सके।
beats.on_screen: ₹100 versus ₹500: identify value category.

beats.say: Data बंद हो तो? MANI Android और iOS पर installation के बाद offline, यानी बिना internet चलता है; Hindi-English समेत 15 languages हैं।
beats.on_screen: Both platforms; 15 languages; offline AFTER installation.

beats.say: App की 15 languages को note के 15 plus 2 से मत मिलाना; platform और language choices access बढ़ाते हैं।
beats.on_screen: App language count versus banknote language count.

beats.say: Graphic में audio और vibration बिना देखे पहचान के रास्ते हैं; offline icon installation के बाद का काम बताता है।
beats.on_screen: Speaker and vibration icons demonstrate independent access; offline icon corroborates operation after installation.

beats.say: दो platforms, 15 languages, installed app offline; पहचान authenticity test नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Access capabilities; denomination recognition ≠ authentication.

beats.say: Phone जवाब कैसे देता है? Note की image लेकर रकम sound या vibration से पहुँचाता है।
beats.on_screen: Introduce graphic reading path: camera input → audio → vibration → offline icon.

beats.say: Front या back, कोई side scan करो; camera image input देता है। Audio output denomination सुनाता है, इसलिए screen पढ़ना जरूरी नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Either note face → camera → audible denomination.

beats.say: सुन भी न सकें तो? Vision-hearing impairment में vibration हाथ से महसूस होती है। Network icon installed app का offline use बताता है, offline download नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Vibration felt in hand; offline AFTER installation.

beats.say: Input image है; result सुनकर या छूकर मिलता है।
beats.on_screen: Visual input and alternative sensory outputs.

beats.say: Scan करो, सुनो या vibration पाओ; installation के बाद data जरूरी नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Complete labelled MANI graphic linked to independent denomination identification.

beats.say: ₹100 का promise क्या हमेशा उतना सामान दिलाता है? Note दिखे नहीं, तो उसकी value कैसे पहचानोगे?
beats.on_screen: ₹100 note, basket and phone.

beats.say: छोटे अंक न दिखें तो? Accessibility Features यानी पहचान आसान बनाने वाली बनावट: raised printing और identification marks छूकर पहचानो; larger numerals और distinct note sizes भी मदद करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Whole note: tactile marks, larger numerals, different sizes.

beats.say: रोशनी में कौन दिखता है? Watermark में Mahatma Gandhi कागज़ के भीतर दिखते हैं, ऊपर छपा portrait नहीं। Security Thread कागज़ में डाली पतली strip है; उसके भारत, RBI और denomination देखो, सिर्फ dark line नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Against light: reveal paper watermark; zoom into incorporated thread and inscriptions. Do not invent exact positions.

beats.say: Tilt पर चित्र उभरे? Latent Image देखने का angle बदलकर जाँचते हैं। See-through Register में आगे-पीछे के अधूरे निशान रोशनी में पूरी denomination बनाते हैं; यहाँ दोनों faces का alignment जाँचते हो, भीतर बना portrait नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Tilt to reveal latent image; then transmitted light aligns opposite-face portions. Contrast with watermark.

beats.say: Lens में छोटी line अक्षर बन जाए तो? Micro-lettering यानी बहुत छोटे अक्षरों में RBI और denomination; crude copy में ये धुँधले मिल सकते हैं। Higher denominations की Optically Variable Ink यानी tilt पर रंग बदलने वाली ink, जैसे चमकीला card घुमाओ; छिपा चित्र उभरना अलग check है।
beats.on_screen: Magnify fine printing: a tiny line resolves into RBI and denomination. Tilt ink to show colour change; contrast with latent-image appearance. Do not assert exact positions.

beats.say: उँगली से उभार मिले? Intaglio Printing में छपे हिस्से raised होते हैं, पूरा कागज़ नहीं। Number Panels में छोटे से बड़े होते digits trace करो; यह printing-pattern check है, रकम बढ़ना नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Feel selected raised printed areas; trace increasing physical digit size in number panel, separate from language panel.

beats.say: भीतर की बनावट और बारीक छपाई अलग checks देते हैं; Intaglio touch-based पहचान भी देता है।
beats.on_screen: Connect paper construction, fine printing and raised detail to their checking functions.

beats.say: Checks साथ लगाओ; features denomination और design के साथ बदल सकते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Combine inspection actions; consult denomination-specific design.

beats.say: रास्ता याद रखो: light, tilt, magnify और touch।
beats.on_screen: Labelled recap of all eight security features and accessibility aids along the inspection path.

beats.say: ₹1 note कौन issue करता है? Government of India; signature Finance Secretary का है और circulation RBI संभालता है, यानी लोगों-बैंकों के बीच चलना।
beats.on_screen: ₹1: Government issues; Finance Secretary signs; RBI manages circulation.

beats.say: पीछे language panel में क्या दिखता है? यानी एक ही रकम 15 languages में लिखी है। Note के features मिलाने के लिए RBI की पैसा बोलता है website देख सकते हो।
beats.on_screen: Reverse language panel: highlight the same monetary amount expressed in 15 languages. Official RBI feature reference: https://paisaboltahai.rbi.org.in/

beats.say: सामने Hindi और English जोड़ो तो total 17 हैं; जैसे कमरे और पूरे घर की गिनती अलग होती है।
beats.on_screen: Reverse 15 + front 2 = total 17.

beats.say: RBI reference से denomination-specific features मिलाओ। ₹1 का circulation RBI संभालता है; इससे वह issuer नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: Official feature reference; circulation ≠ issue.

beats.say: Statement trap पकड़ो: panel में 17 गलत है; circulation संभालना और issuer होना अलग काम हैं।
beats.on_screen: Panel 17: false. RBI issuer of ₹1: false.

beats.say: 15 plus 2; तीन institutional roles; features के लिए RBI reference याद रखो।
beats.on_screen: 15 + 2 = 17; issuer/signatory/circulation; official feature reference.

beats.say: किराना bill ₹100 है; genuine ₹100 note दो तो? दुकानदार ने लिया, अब ₹0 बाकी हैं; payment में कागज़ नहीं, उस पर लिखे ₹100 काम आए।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical grocery bill ₹100 → ₹0.

beats.say: Customer ने tea seller को ₹20 का note दिया; उसने वही milk seller को दिया। पहले दोनों के पास इस note के ₹0 थे; अब बारी-बारी ₹20 मिले, बिना नाम बदले।
beats.on_screen: Lawful transfer: customer → tea seller → milk seller.

beats.say: Wallet का ₹100 interest कमाएगा? नहीं। ग्राहक ने groceries के लिए वह note दिया; उसके पास ₹0 बचे। Shopkeeper के पास पहले इस note के ₹0 थे, अब ₹100 मिले।
beats.on_screen: No interest from holding; unnamed ₹100 transferred.

beats.say: खरीदार ₹500 debt चुकाने का unconditional written commitment देता है। बाद में उसने currency में ₹500 चुका दिए; अब ₹0 बाकी हैं। Written commitment और payment की currency अलग हैं।
beats.on_screen: Illustrative written repayment commitment; later currency payment.

beats.say: लिखी amount face value है; Promise Clause उस face value की RBI guarantee बताता है। Bearer वह है जिसके पास note है, किसी तय व्यक्ति का नाम जरूरी नहीं; इसीलिए मिला हुआ cash अगले payment में चलता है।
beats.on_screen: Face value: stated amount. Bearer: present holder.

beats.say: इसीलिए zero interest, anonymous bearer bond कहते हैं: interest नहीं, holder का नाम नहीं, इस्तेमाल bearer करता है; promise nominal amount का है।
beats.on_screen: Zero interest / unnamed holder / bearer use.

beats.say: Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 के Section 4 extract में promissory note written instrument है, जिसमें unconditional undertaking यानी बिना शर्त वादा हो; ‘not being a bank-note or a currency-note’ इन्हें बाहर रखता है।
beats.on_screen: Section 4 extract: written instrument; unconditional undertaking; explicit exclusions.

beats.say: ‘फसल अच्छी हुई तो दूँगा’ unconditional नहीं है। Bearer bond यहाँ shorthand है, ordinary investment bond नहीं; anonymous से हर transaction untraceable नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: Conditional non-example; shorthand is not full legal classification.

beats.say: Face value, bearer और legal category अलग रखो; यह पूरी statutory definition नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Monetary meanings versus statutory classification; quotation is an extract.

beats.say: Note देकर silver मिले तो? एक hypothetical counter पर holder ने ₹100 का note दिया और बदले में 10 grams silver लिया। यह historical rate नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Explicitly hypothetical parity: holder hands over ₹100 note and receives 10 g silver. Not an actual colonial rate.

beats.say: Authority ने अपने 100 grams stock से 10 grams दिए; अब 90 grams बचे। लौटाया note cancel करके ₹100 की liability हटाई। Colonial era में gold या silver bars अथवा coins में conversion का promise था; full bodied coin की metal value बताई कीमत के करीब थी।
beats.on_screen: Authority takes 10 g from a hypothetical 100 g stock, leaving 90 g; cancels returned ₹100 note and removes corresponding liability. Then identify historical metal conversion and full-bodied coin.

beats.say: Metal quantity तय नियम से मिलती थी, कागज़ के वजन से नहीं; modern note ऐसा redemption नहीं देता।
beats.on_screen: Historical terms varied by system and period; modern note has no specified metal redemption.

beats.say: पुराना run था: note लौटाओ, metal लो, note cancel हो।
beats.on_screen: Historical convertible arrangement: surrender → metal transfer → cancellation; hypothetical numbers remain labelled.

beats.say: पुराने Dollar और Pound में क्या साझा था? Bretton Woods का Dollar और British Rule का Pound Sterling metal से जुड़े थे; यानी कागज़ के पीछे metal लेने का रास्ता था।
beats.on_screen: Shared historical metal link; actual redemption terms differed across systems.

beats.say: मान लो चावल ₹20 से ₹25 per kilogram हुए। ₹100 से 5 की जगह 4 kilograms मिलेंगे; पुराने 5 लेने को ₹125 चाहिए। क्या note बदला?
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical rice example: ₹20 → ₹25/kg; 5 → 4 kg; 20% less rice.

beats.say: नहीं; face value वही, purchasing power कम है: note inflation adjusted नहीं। Metal redemption अलग अधिकार है; modern note gold या silver weight से linked नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Separate criteria: purchasing power and metal redemption.

beats.say: Currency पर promise है, तो legal promissory note है? नहीं; Section 4 का express exclusion मिलता-जुलता wording होने पर भी category अलग करता है।
beats.on_screen: Promise clause present; legal promissory-note category excluded.

beats.say: Prices बढ़ें तो cash अपने आप नहीं बढ़ता; एक good का example broader inflation नहीं। Bretton Woods में Dollar का gold redemption foreign official holders के लिए था, हर retail bearer के लिए नहीं।
beats.on_screen: No automatic cash adjustment. Historical clarification: official-holder convertibility was not unrestricted retail redemption.
beats.source: Federal Reserve History, Closing the Gold Window, 2013.

beats.say: सबसे confusing pair है promise की भाषा और statutory category; exam में bracket वाला exclusion निर्णायक है।
beats.on_screen: Confused pair: promise wording versus statutory classification. Highlight 'not being a bank-note or a currency-note'.

beats.say: चार tests अलग हैं: face value, purchasing power, metal redemption और legal category।
beats.on_screen: Four-row comparison table.

beats.say: ₹100 specimen में ऊपर-नीचे क्या है? दोनों languages का promise ऊपर है और Governor का signature नीचे; अब इन्हें पहचानो।
beats.on_screen: Enlarged described ₹100 promise/signature crop.

beats.say: बाएँ Hindi, दाएँ English में वही ₹100 हैं, ₹200 नहीं। ‘I PROMISE TO PAY’ रकम देने का वादा है; ‘THE BEARER’ यानी note रखने वाले से यह वादा है।
beats.on_screen: Show complete supplied bilingual promise; connect both amounts to one ₹100 note and bearer to its holder.

beats.say: नीचे Raghuram G. Rajan का नाम, signature और Governor title दिखते हैं। यह specimen का signatory है, current-office दावा नहीं; ₹1 पर Finance Secretary sign करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Show supplied रघुराम जी. राजन, handwritten signature, गवर्नर and GOVERNOR labels; specimen only.

beats.say: Amount, bearer और इस instrument का signatory पहचानो।
beats.on_screen: Highlight amount → bearer → specimen signatory.

beats.say: इस crop का रास्ता है: दोनों भाषाओं में एक रकम, फिर नीचे signatory।
beats.on_screen: Labelled specimen reading path: matching Hindi and English ₹100 promises → signature and title.

beats.say: दुकान पर note पढ़ न सको तो? दूसरों से पूछे बिना value पहचानना accessibility की जरूरत है।
beats.on_screen: Visually impaired user choosing a note at a shop.

beats.say: RBI ने 1 January 2020 को free MANI—Mobile Aided Note Identifier—launch किया; यानी phone से note पहचानने की मदद।
beats.on_screen: 1 January 2020; RBI; free MANI.

beats.say: पहचान में मदद अब phone से भी मिल सकती थी।
beats.on_screen: After launch: a phone-based identification aid becomes available.

beats.say: Launch याद रखो: RBI, 1 January 2020।
beats.on_screen: Timeline recap: RBI launches free MANI on 1 January 2020.

beats.say: हाथ में ₹100 है या ₹500? Denomination यानी note की value पहचानना MANI का उद्देश्य है, ताकि visually impaired व्यक्ति खुद पहचान सके।
beats.on_screen: ₹100 versus ₹500: identify value category.

beats.say: Data बंद हो तो? MANI Android और iOS पर installation के बाद offline, यानी बिना internet चलता है; Hindi-English समेत 15 languages हैं।
beats.on_screen: Both platforms; 15 languages; offline AFTER installation.

beats.say: App की 15 languages को note के 15 plus 2 से मत मिलाना; platform और language choices access बढ़ाते हैं।
beats.on_screen: App language count versus banknote language count.

beats.say: Audio और vibration icons दिखाते हैं कि जवाब बिना देखे मिलता है; network icon offline working की पुष्टि करता है।
beats.on_screen: Evidence: speaker and vibration icons support nonvisual access; disconnected-network icon confirms offline operation after installation.

beats.say: MANI denomination पहचानता है, note genuine है या नहीं यह नहीं जाँचता; यही इसकी सीमा है।
beats.on_screen: Purpose and limit: denomination identification ≠ authentication. RBI clarification, 1 January 2020.
beats.source: Reserve Bank of India, RBI launches Mobile Aided Note Identifier (MANI) for visually challenged persons, press release, 1 January 2020.

beats.say: Phone जवाब कैसे देता है? Note की image लेकर रकम sound या vibration से पहुँचाता है।
beats.on_screen: Introduce graphic reading path: camera input → audio → vibration → offline icon.

beats.say: Front या back, कोई side scan करो; camera image input देता है। Audio output denomination सुनाता है, इसलिए screen पढ़ना जरूरी नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Either note face → camera → audible denomination.

beats.say: सुन भी न सकें तो? Vision-hearing impairment में vibration हाथ से महसूस होती है। Network icon installed app का offline use बताता है, offline download नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Vibration felt in hand; offline AFTER installation.

beats.say: Input image है; result सुनकर या छूकर मिलता है।
beats.on_screen: Visual input and alternative sensory outputs.

beats.say: Graphic का रास्ता याद रखो: camera से input, sound या vibration से output।
beats.on_screen: Labelled graphic recap: either note face → camera input → audio or vibration output. Retain the offline-after-installation label without repeating narration.

beats.say: अब note की बनावट, उसका monetary promise और पहचान में मदद करने वाला tool अलग-अलग समझ सकते हो।
beats.on_screen: Closing synthesis: physical note features / monetary meaning / accessible identification.

beats.say: ₹100 का promise क्या हमेशा उतना सामान दिलाता है? Note दिखे नहीं, तो उसकी value कैसे पहचानोगे?
beats.on_screen: ₹100 note, basket and phone.

beats.say: छोटे अंक न दिखें तो? Accessibility Features यानी पहचान आसान बनाने वाली बनावट: raised printing और identification marks छूकर पहचानो; larger numerals और distinct note sizes भी मदद करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Whole note: tactile marks, larger numerals, different sizes.

beats.say: रोशनी में कौन दिखता है? Watermark में Mahatma Gandhi कागज़ के भीतर दिखते हैं, ऊपर छपा portrait नहीं। Security Thread कागज़ में डाली पतली strip है; उसके भारत, RBI और denomination देखो, सिर्फ dark line नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Against light: reveal paper watermark; zoom into incorporated thread and inscriptions. Do not invent exact positions.

beats.say: Tilt पर चित्र उभरे? Latent Image देखने का angle बदलकर जाँचते हैं। See-through Register में आगे-पीछे के अधूरे निशान रोशनी में पूरी denomination बनाते हैं; यहाँ दोनों faces का alignment जाँचते हो, भीतर बना portrait नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Tilt to reveal latent image; then transmitted light aligns opposite-face portions. Contrast with watermark.

beats.say: Lens में छोटी line अक्षर बन जाए तो? Micro-lettering यानी बहुत छोटे अक्षरों में RBI और denomination; crude copy में ये धुँधले मिल सकते हैं। Higher denominations की Optically Variable Ink यानी tilt पर रंग बदलने वाली ink, जैसे चमकीला card घुमाओ; छिपा चित्र उभरना अलग check है।
beats.on_screen: Magnify fine printing: a tiny line resolves into RBI and denomination. Tilt ink to show colour change; contrast with latent-image appearance. Do not assert exact positions.

beats.say: उँगली से उभार मिले? Intaglio Printing में छपे हिस्से raised होते हैं, पूरा कागज़ नहीं। Number Panels में छोटे से बड़े होते digits trace करो; यह printing-pattern check है, रकम बढ़ना नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Feel selected raised printed areas; trace increasing physical digit size in number panel, separate from language panel.

beats.say: भीतर की बनावट और बारीक छपाई अलग checks देते हैं; Intaglio touch-based पहचान भी देता है।
beats.on_screen: Connect paper construction, fine printing and raised detail to their checking functions.

beats.say: Checks साथ लगाओ; features denomination और design के साथ बदल सकते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Combine inspection actions; consult denomination-specific design.

beats.say: रास्ता याद रखो: light, tilt, magnify और touch।
beats.on_screen: Labelled recap of all eight security features and accessibility aids along the inspection path.

beats.say: ₹1 note कौन issue करता है? Government of India; signature Finance Secretary का है और circulation RBI संभालता है, यानी लोगों-बैंकों के बीच चलना।
beats.on_screen: ₹1: Government issues; Finance Secretary signs; RBI manages circulation.

beats.say: पीछे language panel में क्या दिखता है? यानी एक ही रकम 15 languages में लिखी है। Note के features मिलाने के लिए RBI की पैसा बोलता है website देख सकते हो।
beats.on_screen: Reverse language panel: highlight the same monetary amount expressed in 15 languages. Official RBI feature reference: https://paisaboltahai.rbi.org.in/

beats.say: सामने Hindi और English जोड़ो तो total 17 हैं; जैसे कमरे और पूरे घर की गिनती अलग होती है।
beats.on_screen: Reverse 15 + front 2 = total 17.

beats.say: RBI reference से denomination-specific features मिलाओ। ₹1 का circulation RBI संभालता है; इससे वह issuer नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: Official feature reference; circulation ≠ issue.

beats.say: Statement trap पकड़ो: panel में 17 गलत है; circulation संभालना और issuer होना अलग काम हैं।
beats.on_screen: Panel 17: false. RBI issuer of ₹1: false.

beats.say: 15 plus 2; तीन institutional roles; features के लिए RBI reference याद रखो।
beats.on_screen: 15 + 2 = 17; issuer/signatory/circulation; official feature reference.

beats.say: किराना bill ₹100 है; genuine ₹100 note दो तो? दुकानदार ने लिया, अब ₹0 बाकी हैं; payment में कागज़ नहीं, उस पर लिखे ₹100 काम आए।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical grocery bill ₹100 → ₹0.

beats.say: Customer ने tea seller को ₹20 का note दिया; उसने वही milk seller को दिया। पहले दोनों के पास इस note के ₹0 थे; अब बारी-बारी ₹20 मिले, बिना नाम बदले।
beats.on_screen: Lawful transfer: customer → tea seller → milk seller.

beats.say: Wallet का ₹100 interest कमाएगा? नहीं। ग्राहक ने groceries के लिए वह note दिया; उसके पास ₹0 बचे। Shopkeeper के पास पहले इस note के ₹0 थे, अब ₹100 मिले।
beats.on_screen: No interest from holding; unnamed ₹100 transferred.

beats.say: खरीदार ₹500 debt चुकाने का unconditional written commitment देता है। बाद में उसने currency में ₹500 चुका दिए; अब ₹0 बाकी हैं। Written commitment और payment की currency अलग हैं।
beats.on_screen: Illustrative written repayment commitment; later currency payment.

beats.say: लिखी amount face value है; Promise Clause उस face value की RBI guarantee बताता है। Bearer वह है जिसके पास note है, किसी तय व्यक्ति का नाम जरूरी नहीं; इसीलिए मिला हुआ cash अगले payment में चलता है।
beats.on_screen: Face value: stated amount. Bearer: present holder.

beats.say: इसीलिए zero interest, anonymous bearer bond कहते हैं: interest नहीं, holder का नाम नहीं, इस्तेमाल bearer करता है; promise nominal amount का है।
beats.on_screen: Zero interest / unnamed holder / bearer use.

beats.say: Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 के Section 4 extract में promissory note written instrument है, जिसमें unconditional undertaking यानी बिना शर्त वादा हो; ‘not being a bank-note or a currency-note’ इन्हें बाहर रखता है।
beats.on_screen: Section 4 extract: written instrument; unconditional undertaking; explicit exclusions.

beats.say: ‘फसल अच्छी हुई तो दूँगा’ unconditional नहीं है। Bearer bond यहाँ shorthand है, ordinary investment bond नहीं; anonymous से हर transaction untraceable नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: Conditional non-example; shorthand is not full legal classification.

beats.say: Face value, bearer और legal category अलग रखो; यह पूरी statutory definition नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Monetary meanings versus statutory classification; quotation is an extract.

beats.say: Note देकर silver मिले तो? एक hypothetical counter पर holder ने ₹100 का note दिया और बदले में 10 grams silver लिया। यह historical rate नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Explicitly hypothetical parity: holder hands over ₹100 note and receives 10 g silver. Not an actual colonial rate.

beats.say: Authority ने अपने 100 grams stock से 10 grams दिए; अब 90 grams बचे। लौटाया note cancel करके ₹100 की liability हटाई। Colonial era में gold या silver bars अथवा coins में conversion का promise था; full bodied coin की metal value बताई कीमत के करीब थी।
beats.on_screen: Authority takes 10 g from a hypothetical 100 g stock, leaving 90 g; cancels returned ₹100 note and removes corresponding liability. Then identify historical metal conversion and full-bodied coin.

beats.say: Metal quantity तय नियम से मिलती थी, कागज़ के वजन से नहीं; modern note ऐसा redemption नहीं देता।
beats.on_screen: Historical terms varied by system and period; modern note has no specified metal redemption.

beats.say: पुराना run था: note लौटाओ, metal लो, note cancel हो।
beats.on_screen: Historical convertible arrangement: surrender → metal transfer → cancellation; hypothetical numbers remain labelled.

beats.say: पुराने Dollar और Pound में क्या साझा था? Bretton Woods का Dollar और British Rule का Pound Sterling metal से जुड़े थे; यानी कागज़ के पीछे metal लेने का रास्ता था।
beats.on_screen: Shared historical metal link; actual redemption terms differed across systems.

beats.say: मान लो चावल ₹20 से ₹25 per kilogram हुए। ₹100 से 5 की जगह 4 kilograms मिलेंगे; पुराने 5 लेने को ₹125 चाहिए। क्या note बदला?
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical rice example: ₹20 → ₹25/kg; 5 → 4 kg; 20% less rice.

beats.say: नहीं; face value वही, purchasing power कम है: note inflation adjusted नहीं। Metal redemption अलग अधिकार है; modern note gold या silver weight से linked नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Separate criteria: purchasing power and metal redemption.

beats.say: Currency पर promise है, तो legal promissory note है? नहीं; Section 4 का express exclusion मिलता-जुलता wording होने पर भी category अलग करता है।
beats.on_screen: Promise clause present; legal promissory-note category excluded.

beats.say: Prices बढ़ें तो cash अपने आप नहीं बढ़ता; एक good का example broader inflation नहीं। Bretton Woods में Dollar का gold redemption foreign official holders के लिए था, हर retail bearer के लिए नहीं।
beats.on_screen: No automatic cash adjustment. Historical clarification: official-holder convertibility was not unrestricted retail redemption.
beats.source: Federal Reserve History, Closing the Gold Window, 2013.

beats.say: सबसे confusing pair है promise की भाषा और statutory category; exam में bracket वाला exclusion देखो।
beats.on_screen: Confused pair: promise wording versus statutory classification. Highlight 'not being a bank-note or a currency-note'.

beats.say: चार tests अलग हैं: face value, purchasing power, metal redemption और legal category।
beats.on_screen: Four-row comparison table.

beats.say: ₹100 specimen में ऊपर-नीचे क्या है? दोनों languages का promise ऊपर है और Governor का signature नीचे; अब इन्हें पहचानो।
beats.on_screen: Enlarged described ₹100 promise/signature crop.

beats.say: बाएँ Hindi, दाएँ English में वही ₹100 हैं, ₹200 नहीं। ‘I PROMISE TO PAY’ रकम देने का वादा है; ‘THE BEARER’ यानी note रखने वाले से यह वादा है।
beats.on_screen: Show complete supplied bilingual promise; connect both amounts to one ₹100 note and bearer to its holder.

beats.say: नीचे Raghuram G. Rajan का नाम, signature और Governor title दिखते हैं। यह specimen का signatory है, current-office दावा नहीं; ₹1 पर Finance Secretary sign करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Show supplied रघुराम जी. राजन, handwritten signature, गवर्नर and GOVERNOR labels; specimen only.

beats.say: Amount, bearer और इस instrument का signatory पहचानो।
beats.on_screen: Highlight amount → bearer → specimen signatory.

beats.say: इस crop का रास्ता है: दोनों भाषाओं में एक रकम, फिर नीचे signatory।
beats.on_screen: Labelled specimen reading path: matching Hindi and English ₹100 promises → signature and title.

beats.say: दुकान पर note पढ़ न सको तो? दूसरों से पूछे बिना value पहचानना accessibility की जरूरत है।
beats.on_screen: Visually impaired user choosing a note at a shop.

beats.say: RBI ने 1 January 2020 को free MANI—Mobile Aided Note Identifier—launch किया; यानी phone से note पहचानने की मदद।
beats.on_screen: 1 January 2020; RBI; free MANI.

beats.say: पहचान में मदद अब phone से भी मिल सकती थी।
beats.on_screen: After launch: a phone-based identification aid becomes available.

beats.say: Launch याद रखो: RBI, 1 January 2020।
beats.on_screen: Timeline recap: RBI launches free MANI on 1 January 2020.

beats.say: हाथ में ₹100 है या ₹500? Denomination यानी note की value पहचानना MANI का उद्देश्य है, ताकि visually impaired व्यक्ति खुद पहचान सके।
beats.on_screen: ₹100 versus ₹500: identify value category.

beats.say: Data बंद हो तो? MANI Android और iOS पर installation के बाद offline, यानी बिना internet चलता है; Hindi-English समेत 15 languages हैं।
beats.on_screen: Both platforms; 15 languages; offline AFTER installation.

beats.say: App की 15 languages को note के 15 plus 2 से मत मिलाना; platform और language choices access बढ़ाते हैं।
beats.on_screen: App language count versus banknote language count.

beats.say: Audio और vibration icons दिखाते हैं कि जवाब बिना देखे मिलता है; network icon offline working दिखाता है।
beats.on_screen: Evidence: speaker and vibration icons support nonvisual access; disconnected-network icon confirms offline operation after installation.

beats.say: MANI denomination पहचानता है, note genuine है या नहीं यह नहीं जाँचता; यही इसकी सीमा है।
beats.on_screen: Purpose and limit: denomination identification ≠ authentication. RBI clarification, 1 January 2020.
beats.source: Reserve Bank of India, RBI launches Mobile Aided Note Identifier (MANI) for visually challenged persons, press release, 1 January 2020.

beats.say: Phone जवाब कैसे देता है? Note की image लेकर रकम sound या vibration से पहुँचाता है।
beats.on_screen: Introduce graphic reading path: camera input → audio → vibration → offline icon.

beats.say: Front या back, कोई side scan करो; camera image input देता है। Audio output denomination सुनाता है, इसलिए screen पढ़ना जरूरी नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Either note face → camera → audible denomination.

beats.say: सुन भी न सकें तो? Vision-hearing impairment में vibration हाथ से महसूस होती है। Network icon installed app का offline use बताता है, offline download नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Vibration felt in hand; offline AFTER installation.

beats.say: Input image है; result सुनकर या छूकर मिलता है।
beats.on_screen: Visual input and alternative sensory outputs.

beats.say: Graphic का रास्ता याद रखो: camera से input, sound या vibration से output।
beats.on_screen: Labelled graphic recap: either note face → camera input → audio or vibration output. Retain the offline-after-installation label without repeating narration.

beats.say: अब note की बनावट, उसका monetary promise और पहचान में मदद करने वाला tool अलग-अलग समझ सकते हो।
beats.on_screen: Closing synthesis: physical note features / monetary meaning / accessible identification.

notes.about: This unit connects banknote security and accessibility features with monetary promises, legal classification and MANI. It prepares learners to distinguish identifying a denomination from authenticating a note.
key_questions: How do the note's different features support recognition and checking?
What does the promise guarantee, and what does it not guarantee?
Why is currency excluded from the statutory promissory-note category?
How does MANI support independent identification, and what are its limits?
